listing.title: Handcrafted Buffalo Leather Kolhapuri Chappals with Intricate Braiding
listing.description: These authentic Kolhapuri chappals are meticulously hand-stitched from buffalo leather, a process that takes two days of dedicated craftsmanship. Originating from the heritage clusters of Maharashtra, this footwear features traditional braided straps and punched leather patterns, embodying a centuries-old artisanal legacy.
